senses.definition: n.pr.loc. Ju 3:3 1 Ch 5:23, a city so named as seat of the worship of Baal. ‘The crest of Hermon is strewn with ruins and the foundations of a circular temple of large hewn stones,’ TristrTpg., cf. on sacredness, Euseb. LagOnom 217: possibly = בעל גד q.v.
